chapter: Sam Morgan, La Vida and Ridgley
title: The La Vida taxi dance hall band and its long hours
summary: Williams went to La Vida in 1927 and lists the band; he describes the long hours and taking breaks while others drummed.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: The street taxi dance hall. Our band consists of Raymond Brown, which is Clifford. We call him Clifford, but his name is Raymond. He lives in Frisco. Bat Brown's nephew. Yeah, yeah. And him, and Handley, Williams Kelly, Lewis Gibbons, and Sidney Flutcher. That was our band at the La Vida. How long did you stay there about? I stayed there. I went there in 27. I stayed there about a year.
Oh, hours. Hours. Hours. That's all it was. That's all? That's all it was. Hours. Hours. Let's talk about that.
Did you take a turn about getting off the stand to get a little rest sometime, or how'd you do that?
Yeah, well, I just walk off the stand, and somebody else would get on the drum, you know, until I come back. We'd take time.
Any of the other guys in the band play drums?
